name: Flying Thunder God - Reverse Seal Summoning

system.description:
In order to cast this jutsu you must have a creature, object or structure marked with the Sealing Art: Chakra Seal ninjutsu, that you cast.

You select up to 6 willing creatures with a chakra seal, meant as a companion for the Sealing Art: Chakra Seal.

As part of casting this jutsu, you and all marked creatures within 10 feet of you, teleports to the creature, object or structure marked with the Sealing Art: Chakra Seal so long as it is no more than 10 miles away. You and each creature teleport, and begin occupying spaces within 15 feet of actual seals placement. The target seal you teleported to is then dispelled.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, reduce the casting time of this jutsu down to 1 Action.
